data.exact_reserve_text: The 2014 net technical result of GBP 42.4m (2013: GBP 49.1m) includes GBP 27.7m (2013: GBP 39.9m) of releases from reserves in respect of prior accident years.

prior_year_events.impact_description: The Syndicate's conservative approach to reserving has meant that continued deterioration of this loss in financial terms has not adversely affected the Syndicate's net position.

named_events.loss_description: significant aviation war losses including the horrific loss of Malaysian Airlines flight MH17 over the Ukraine... had a significant impact on the Syndicate's aviation war portfolio, however the net effect on the portfolio was moderated to acceptable levels by the Syndicate's reinsurance programme.

prolonged attack on Tripoli airport in Libya... significant aviation war losses... had a significant impact on the Syndicate's aviation war portfolio, however the net effect on the portfolio was moderated to acceptable levels by the Syndicate's reinsurance programme.

The tragic loss of the "Costa Concordia" was noted in the 2012 report. The Syndicate's conservative approach to reserving has meant that continued deterioration of this loss in financial terms has not adversely affected the Syndicate's net position.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a net release of GBP 27.7 million from reserves in respect of prior accident years. This favorable development was partly attributed to the syndicate's conservative reserving approach, which meant that the tragic 2012 Costa Concordia loss did not adversely affect the net position.
